function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力（電）作為自然現象早在古代就已被人類觀察到，例如古希臘哲學家對靜電的研究。但若談「系統性地發現並描述電的本質」，通常歸功於以下幾位科學家：

| 時期 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 1600 年代 | 威廉·吉爾伯特（William Gilbert） | 在《De Magnete》一書中首次將電與磁區分，提出「電」這個概念，奠定電學基礎。 |
| 1700 年代 | 本傑明·富蘭克林（Benjamin Franklin） | 以雷電實驗證明電荷可被儲存、傳遞，提出正負電荷概念。 |
| 1800 年代 | 阿萊桑德羅·伏打（Alessandro Volta） | 發明伏打電池，證明電流可以由化學反應產生，開創電化學研究。 |
| 19 世紀末 | 詹姆斯·克拉克·麥克斯韋（James Clerk Maxwell） | 整合電磁學，提出電磁波方程式，預言光是電磁波。 |

因此，雖然電的存在早已被觀察，但「發現」電並將其納入科學體系，最常被認為是威廉·吉爾伯特的工作。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can provide a concise answer: Electricity was known since antiquity, but its systematic study began with scientists like William Gilbert, Benjamin Franklin, Alessandro Volta, etc. The question might be answered: The discovery of electricity is attributed to many, but the first systematic study was by William Gilbert in 1600s. Or maybe they want the person who discovered electricity as a phenomenon: The ancient Greeks observed static electricity. But the modern discovery: William Gilbert. So answer accordingly. No tool needed.
